            print(f'{mf}: {label} = {found}')

YAML_SPLIT_MODE has three modes:
1. `"flat-timestamped"` — CURRENT mode. Creates numbered YAML files with timestamps in a per-session subdirectory (`ses_XXXX/001-2026-07-26T10-13-47-102Z.yaml`). This is what we see in `.opencode/logs/ses_XXXX/`.
2. `"per-turn"` — Alternative that writes `00-header.yaml`, `0001-turn.yaml`, etc.
3. Anything else — `"single"` — writes a single `ses_XXXX.yaml` file

1. `.jsonl` + `.yaml` — basic log + full YAML export
